data.title: 长离 · 荷池边的海滨茶席
data.description: 【今州海湾荷池·午后】长离穿着桃红色泳装外搭轻便长衫，斜坐在水边木台给自己斟一杯冷茶；荷叶与海风同时掠过她的长发，她抬眼向镜头举杯，笑意从授课时的端庄变得轻盈。
data.action: 荷池海湾木台边斟冷茶举杯，海风吹动长发与桃红外衫
data.lighting: warm afternoon light across water and lotus leaves
data.mood: 长离难得只教自己休息
data.promptProse: Changli sits diagonally on the waterside wooden platform, pouring herself chilled tea before lifting the glass toward the viewer with a lighter smile. Her peach-red swimsuit lies beneath a cream long overshirt and embroidered sash. Lotus leaves and sea breeze move beside her long hair in the horizontal medium view. Warm afternoon light catches the glass rim and leaf edges, with water reflections below the platform and soft sleeve shadows around her wrist.
